description: Create a source-first plan that separates exact embed/source reuse from local capture and bounded rebuild work.

candidates.description: Embed/source candidates as returned by discover_embed_candidates (objects with kind and url).

capture_bundle.description: Capture bundle from the local MCP's capture_reference_bundle, if one exists.

exact_requested.description: True (default) when the user wants an exact, faithful clone; false when an approximate rebuild is acceptable.

license_text.description: License or permission text that allows reusing the page, from the user or the site; informs the reuse/rebuild policy.

site_profile.description: The site_profile object returned by inspect_url.

source_signals.description: Extra hints about the page's origin, e.g. ["framer", "spline", "export"]; merged with signals detected from the page.

name: plan_reproduction_path
title: Plan Reproduction Path
